n1.speaker: kess
n1.text: Oh, don't mind me. Just reorganizing my streaming schedule. At 3am. Like a normal person.

n2.speaker: player
n2.text: (Her laptop is open to a refugee-registry search, not a schedule.)

n3.speaker: kess
n3.text: Don't — it's not a big deal, okay?

choices.text: "It's a big deal if it matters to you."
(Close the laptop gently. Change the subject.)

n4_patience.speaker: kess
n4_patience.text: ...Thanks. Didn't want to get into it tonight.
